policy.decision: Full/partial/no interior support are observational outcomes only. Only an independent physical discriminator could authorize exclusion. No mask union, reweighted score, final suppression, episode relaxation, new candidate, threshold search or ML.
policy.falsification: Reject this as a sufficient repair if the three known texture fronts lack continuation, continuation also occurs in genuine-front/structural controls, or the proposed cue has no independent physical-identity basis. Report failures and named unknowns without tuning.

"""Observe pre-arbitration support; do not replace any production decision."""
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from collections import Counter
import hashlib, json
import cv2
import numpy as np
from oil_tracker.adapters.storage.json_recipe_repository import JsonRecipeRepository
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision import foam_front_detector as owner

root = Path.cwd()
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
load = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text())
pre = load(out/'preflight.json')
inputs = dict(pre['inputs'])
inputs[str((out/'preflight.json').relative_to(root))] = sha(out/'preflight.json')
inputs[str(Path(__file__).relative_to(root))] = sha(Path(__file__))
def verify():
    for name,pin in {**inputs,**pre['sources']}.items():
        assert sha(root/name)==pin,name
verify()
folder = root/'sample/output/s11-local-xy-implementation-20261009-001/v2-sample4-scoped-FULL'
trace = next(folder.glob('oil-debug*/debug_trace.jsonl'))
saved = load(folder/'foam.json')
assert sha(folder/'foam.json')==load(folder/'summary.json')['outputs']['foam.json']
recipe = JsonRecipeRepository().load(root/'sample/output/s11-local-xy-exclusion-20261009-001/sample4-baseline/recipe.oilrecipe')
settings = recipe.glasses[0].detector_settings
points = load(root/'sample/output/s11-local-foam-two-time-review-001-notes/clicked-points.json')
annotation = load(root/'sample/output/s11-local-b-alternative-review-001-notes/reply-001-boundary-correspondence.json')
points['450'] = [dict(x=c['source_x'],y=c['approximate_marked_source_y']) for c in annotation['mapped_columns']]
real_chromatic = owner._chromatic_foam_support
real_priority = owner._has_material_nonstructural_support_component
cases=[]
for index,line in enumerate(trace.read_text().splitlines()):
    rec=json.loads(line);diag=saved[index]; f=diag['frame_index']
    assert not diag['truncated'] and diag['crop_origin']==[543,798]
    def raster(key):
        p=trace.parent/rec['images'][key]
        assert str(p.relative_to(root)) in inputs
        a=cv2.imread(str(p),cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)
        assert a is not None
        return a
    crop,gray,canny,glare,effective,labels = [raster(k) for k in ['original_roi','grayscale','canny','glare_mask','effective_mask','foam_component_labels']]
    assert np.array_equal(gray,cv2.cvtColor(crop,cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY))
    capture={}
    def chromatic(*args):
        result=real_chromatic(*args);capture['warm']=result[0].copy();return result
    def priority(*args):
        result=real_priority(*args);capture['suppressed']=result;return result
    with patch.object(owner,'_chromatic_foam_support',chromatic), patch.object(owner,'_has_material_nonstructural_support_component',priority):
        result=owner.detect_bottom_connected_foam(crop,gray,canny,glare,effective,settings,capture_diagnostics=True)
    assert np.array_equal(result.diagnostic_labels,labels),f
    # Exact comparison of all original diagnostics, excluding projector-added source coordinates.
    for k,v in result.diagnostics.items():
        if k=='components':
            assert len(v)==len(diag[k])
            for a,b in zip(v,diag[k],strict=True):
                assert all(b[key]==value for key,value in a.items()),(f,a,b)
        else:assert v==diag[k],(f,k,v,diag[k])
    warm=capture['warm']; visible=(effective>0)&(glare==0)
    def point(x,y):
        row=dict(source_x=int(x+543),source_y=int(y+798))
        if y<1 or y+1>=gray.shape[0] or not visible[y-1:y+2,x].all():
            row['state']='UNAVAILABLE';return row
        row['membership_above_at_below']=[bool(v) for v in warm[y-1:y+2,x]]
        row['state']='CHROMATIC_INTERIOR' if all(row['membership_above_at_below']) else 'NO_INTERIOR_WITNESS'
        return row
    comps=[]
    for c in diag['components']:
        mask=labels==c['diagnostic_id'];xs=np.flatnonzero(mask.any(axis=0))
        lower=c['predicates']['front_from_lower_edge']
        edge=[point(x,np.flatnonzero(mask[:,x])[-1 if lower else 0]) for x in xs]
        scalar=[point(x,int(c['local_front_y'])) for x in xs]
        comps.append(dict(diagnostic_id=c['diagnostic_id'],selected=c['selected_component'],
                          front_y=c['source_front_y'],from_lower=lower,component=c,
                          edge_points=edge,scalar_points=scalar,
                          edge_counts=dict(Counter(p['state'] for p in edge)),
                          scalar_counts=dict(Counter(p['state'] for p in scalar))))
    human=[point(p['x']-543,p['y']-798) for p in points.get(str(f),[])]
    cases.append(dict(frame_index=f,time_sec=f/30,white_priority=capture['suppressed'],
                      chromatic_support_pixels=int(warm.sum()),components=comps,human_context_points=human))
    if f in [420,450,480,1620,1635,1665,1680]:
        print('FRAME',f,'priority',capture['suppressed'],'warm_pixels',int(warm.sum()))
        for c in comps: print(c['diagnostic_id'],c['selected'],c['front_y'],c['from_lower'],c['edge_counts'],c['scalar_counts'])
        if human: print('approx human context:',dict(Counter(p['state'] for p in human)))
        np.savez_compressed(out/f'measured-f{f}.npz',warm=warm,visible=visible,labels=labels)
verify()
report=dict(schema='s11-foam-cross-appearance-audit-v1',status='MEASURED_NOT_PROMOTED',
            preflight=pre,inputs=inputs,inputs_preserved=True,
            exact_foam_replays=len(cases),full_pipeline_rerun=False,video_decode=False,
            source_changed=False,physical_front_classification='NOT_EVALUATED',
            scripts={p.name:p.read_text() for p in [out/'preflight.py',Path(__file__)]},cases=cases)
assert not (out/'report.json').exists()
(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Exact replays:',len(cases),'preserved inputs:',len(inputs),'production sources:',len(pre['sources']))
